name: A blessing for your week
title: Hello, November.
note: Sunday blessing, Philippians 4:7, 2 slides, no redraws
caption:
Hello, November. A blessing for the month ahead. Send it to someone you are praying for.

Whatever this month holds, may God's peace keep watch over your heart and your thoughts. It is a peace that does not need everything figured out first.

Philippians 4:7 (BSB)

Keep this one close.
